The '''Federal Republic of Amchan''', commonly known as '''Amchan''', is a sovereign [[wikipedia:Unitary_parliamentary_republic|unitary parliamentary]] republic located in the region of [[South Mahea]]. Spanning a total area of 363,049 square kilometres (140,174 sq mi), it is the world’s [[List of countries and dependencies by area|85th largest nation]] by landmass. Amchan is bordered by [[Inrea]] to the west, Ocaun to the north, and the [[Haanian Ocean]] to the east. As of the 1765 estimate, the nation had a population of approximately [[List of countries and dependencies by population|2,236,000 people]]. Its capital and largest city is [[Harnuk]], which serves as the primary hub for the country’s political, cultural, and economic activities.

The early history of the region is defined by the emergence of the [[Folite Kingdoms]] in 733 AFA. This period of decentralised rule transitioned into a more centralised authority with the rise of the [[Amcharian Empire]] in 885 AFA, which led to an invasion of [[Hijita]]. Following a period of constant civil wars under the [[Kiener Dynasty]], the [[Amcha Kingdom]] was established in 1210 AFA, marking a long era of monarchical stability. The nation entered an era of isolation that ended in 1603 when an [[Emara|Emaran]] fleet forced concessions, including the naval port in [[Zardalune]]. It became an [[Easuhura|Easuhuran]] protectorate in 1654 after the [[Cewia affair]]. This period of foreign administration lasted until 1706 AFA, when Amchan successfully [[achieved independence]], leading to the formation of the modern republic after a [[vote over whether to be a monarchy or a republic]].

Amchan is a [[wikipedia:developing country]], [[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|ranking 108th in the Krali Total Development Index]]. It is one of the poorest countries in [[Mahea]] in terms of per capita income; however, large parts of the population are well off. [[Omlo Juaill]] came to office in 1726 and created a [[dictatorship]], which stabilised its power through a [[client network]]. The official language of Amchan is [[Standardised Amchan]], and the [[Diaokiuo]] ethnic group constitute around 85% of the country's population with a sizable [[Ocaun|Ocunese]] minority, mostly located in the north. ___ is the nation's predominant religion, practised by about 80% of the population. Amchan's  [[List of countries by GDP (nominal) per capita|nominal GDP per capita is]] {{lahn}}10,149 in 1765
